employees.title: Employee Management
employees.subtitle: Employee profiles, departments, teams and login accounts
employees.deleteMessage: {{name}} will be deactivated and removed from lists. Attendance and task history is kept and the login account is disabled.
employees.allowRemote: Allow check-in without on-site verification (remote / work from home)
employees.createAccount: Create a login account for this employee
employees.createAccountHint: The employee signs in with the work email and this password.

users.title: Users & Roles
users.subtitle: Login accounts, role assignment and access control
users.rolesHint: Permissions are granted through roles and enforced by the server on every request.
users.roleRequired: At least one role is required
users.resetPasswordFor: Set a new password for {{name}}. All of their sessions will be signed out.
users.deleteMessage: Delete the account of {{name}}? Accounts with task history are disabled instead of deleted.

roleDescriptions.SuperAdmin: Full access: users, roles, departments, teams, settings, all attendance, tasks and reports.
roleDescriptions.Admin: HR / administration: attendance for all employees, corrections with audit trail, reports, exports and task assignment.
roleDescriptions.Manager: Sees and manages only the employees of the departments they manage and teams they lead.
roleDescriptions.Employee: Records own attendance, views own history and works on assigned tasks.

settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Company configuration, attendance rules and on-site verification
settings.allowMultipleShiftsHint: When off, each employee can record attendance only once per working day.
settings.finalizeDelayHint: Delay after the schedule end before absences and missing check-outs are recorded
settings.reminderHoursHint: Notify assignees this many hours before a task is due
settings.noVerification: No verification method is enabled — employees can record attendance from anywhere.
settings.verificationOn: {{count}} verification method(s) enabled — attendance outside the headquarters is rejected.
settings.policyAnyHint: Check-in succeeds when at least one enabled method passes (e.g. GPS OR company Wi-Fi OR QR).
settings.policyAllHint: Check-in succeeds only when every enabled method passes (strictest).
settings.remoteHint: Employees flagged “Allow remote check-in” can record Work From Home without verification.
settings.geofenceHint: The device location must be within the radius of the office.
settings.geoUnsupported: This browser does not support geolocation.
settings.locationSet: Office location set (accuracy ±{{accuracy}} m). Remember to save.
settings.networkHint: The request must come from an allowed IP address or range (office Wi-Fi / LAN).
settings.ipRangesHint: One per line or comma separated, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24
settings.proxyHint: If the API runs behind a reverse proxy, configure ReverseProxy:KnownProxies so the real client IP is used.
settings.qrHint: Employees scan a code shown on the entrance screen; codes expire automatically.
settings.regenerateQrConfirm: All QR codes currently displayed become invalid immediately. Continue?
settings.qrSaveFirst: Save the settings before opening the kiosk screen.
settings.schedulesHint: Working hours, grace periods and weekends used for late / absence calculations.
settings.timeOrder: End time must be after start time.
settings.holidaysHint: Holidays are excluded from absence detection.
